mapper.select: select a.id, a.account_name, a.api_key_no, a.api_key, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.status, a.type, a.pull_type, a.pull_channel, a.pull_url, a.pull_user, a.creator, cu.user_name as creator_name, a.create_time, a.updater, uu.user_name as updater_name, a.update_time from crm_supplier_account a left join crm_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join sys_user cu on a.creator = cu.user_id left join sys_user uu on a.updater = uu.user_id where a.id = #{id}
